page_title: SOU 0-0 MCI | Southampton v Manchester City 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tim Robinson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+3' Mateus Fernandes will be replaced by William Smallbone (Southampton).

90+3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.

90+2' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

90+1' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
88' Simon Rusk prepares a substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana is replaced by Ross Stewart (Southampton).
88' Simon Rusk decides to make a substitution. Welington will be replaced by Ryan Manning (Southampton).

86' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Aaron Ramsdale makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
85' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
85' The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.

85' Aaron Ramsdale makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Ruben Dias (Manchester City) after a cross from the side. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.
84' Today's match ends for Mateo Kovacic who will be replaced by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).
84' Manchester City take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Savinho (Manchester City) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and Aaron Ramsdale makes a simple save.
82' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
82' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) was too forceful with his tackle and Tim Robinson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
80' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
80' An attempted cross from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is cleared.
77' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
76' A pass lands at the feet of Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
76' Here is a change. Rico Lewis is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Phil Foden will be replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).

75' Phil Foden (Manchester City) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
73' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Southampton are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
72' The cross into the penalty area from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

71' What a great chance for Manuel Akanji (Manchester City). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
71' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

70' Ederson (Manchester City) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
68' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

67' Welington (Southampton) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Southampton.
65' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Southampton.
65' Substitution. Tyler Dibling walks off the pitch and Cameron Archer (Southampton) comes on as a substitute.
64' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

64' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
63' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) is able to continue to play.
62' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
61' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Phil Foden (Manchester City) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
61' A player from Southampton pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Manchester City will take a free kick near the side line.
60' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
59' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
58' A first-time shot by Phil Foden (Manchester City) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
56' Flynn Downes (Southampton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tim Robinson didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
55' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
54' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton).
50' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
49' Good movement by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. James McAtee (Manchester City) is replaced by Jeremy Doku.
46' Simon Rusk has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Joe Aribo comes on the pitch for Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Manchester City.
45+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' James McAtee (Manchester City) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
44' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
43' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) picks up a yellow card.
42' The referee blows his whistle as Welington (Southampton) was too aggressive in his challenge. Manchester City earn a free kick.
41' James Bree (Southampton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.

39' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tim Robinson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Southampton have been awarded a free kick.
39' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
38' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process. That's a free kick to Manchester City.
37' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Southampton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
36' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
36' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
35' Phil Foden (Manchester City) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

33' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
31' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Manchester City have a free kick.
29' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' The Manchester City players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

28' A cross by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
26' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
25' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) heads on.
24' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

24' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
23' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner.
22' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Tim Robinson has a clear sight and sees a foul from James McAtee (Manchester City). A free kick is awarded to Southampton.
19' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
17' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
16' James McAtee (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
11' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
10' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).

10' The free kick from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Manchester City win a free kick.
8' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
6' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
2' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) leaps to collect the ball.
2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tim Robinson.
